name: How Long Does It Take to Tile a Bathroom? A Real Timeline
title-tag: How Long Does It Take to Tile a Bathroom? Real Timeline
meta-description: How long tiling a bathroom really takes: 2-3 days for a floor, 7-9 for a full bath with shower - day-by-day, including cure times and the 24-hour flood test.
post-summary: February 2, 2027 · A floor-only bathroom takes two to three working days; a full bathroom with a waterproofed shower runs seven to nine, and one of those days is a 24-hour flood test where nothing visibly happens. Here is the real day-by-day calendar, why cure times cannot be compressed, and what moves the schedule in a Mill Creek house.
